purpose: Teach: 今年度/小規模/品目/原価/正社員/商社/同年/定例

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今年度、本気で、絶対、目標、絶対、達成しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: This fiscal year, I want results. Real results. Hit those targets—no excuses.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding tone. Clear enunciation on the key demands. No softening. Leans forward slightly. The weight of expectation in every syllable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、小規模、絶対、案件、絶対、にも、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're giving our full effort to every client—large projects and small ones alike. Thank you for your confidence in us.
lines.style: Steady, respectful cadence. Slightly formal register. Each commitment lands with quiet conviction. Eyes steady on his boss. Measured breathing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 販売、本気で、絶対、品目、絶対、増やせ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Expand the product line. I need more variety in what we're selling.
lines.style: Direct instruction, clipped rhythm. No elaboration needed—expects understanding. Tone drops slightly at the end, definitive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、原価、絶対、低減、絶対、努めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively working to reduce our production costs. That's a priority for us.
lines.style: Professional, composed response. Slightly faster pace than before—demonstrating action already underway. Small note of pride in the work being done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約社員、本気で、絶対、正社員、絶対、登用、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want to see contract staff moved into permanent positions. Make that happen.
lines.style: Firm, no-nonsense delivery. Slight pause before the final phrase to signal finality. Lower register, the tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。大手、本気で、絶対、商社、絶対、と、絶対、提携、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently in talks with several major trading companies about partnership opportunities.
lines.style: Measured, professional tone. Slightly tentative on the word 'currently'—showing work in progress. Careful articulation of progress without overpromising.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 山田さんと、本気で、絶対、同年、絶対、入社、絶対、田中さん、絶対、表彰しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Yamada and Tanaka came in the same year. I want them both recognized for their contribution.
lines.style: Approving, warmer than before. Slight emphasis on both names. Clear instruction delivered with genuine respect. The voice of someone who notices loyalty and effort.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、定例、絶対、ミーティング、絶対、改善しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We've already streamlined our regular team meetings to make them more efficient.
lines.style: Closing statement—slightly lighter tone. Professional but with subtle relief that key directives have been acknowledged. Confident in what's been shared.
